default_runtime_live_block.note: Default CLI chooses default_runtime_registry when no registry is injected. The dispatcher rejects live mode before runner import; the 013_3 private profile is deny-write/no-runner and declares live/managed_live_direct unavailable.

strategy_custom_broker.note: Strategy buy/sell call its attached broker and Cerebro.setbroker replaces it. This supports broker-polymorphic intent outside bt-runtime registry enforcement; it does not prove any supplied broker reaches a real CTP/provider write.

ctp_candidate_writers.note: The simulation port has explicit write gates, staged binding/approval checks, order-reference resolution and a second _require_write before dispatch. Managed account candidate public __init__ rejects; the sealed-scope factory is separate and docs say unregistered. No default registration or authority is demonstrated.

owned_native_port_forwarder.note: __getattr__ forwards arbitrary attributes to wrapped port; this shows in-process attribute exposure when caller holds the wrapper, not a bypass of the underlying port gates or accepted route.

custom_registry_import_fallback.note: Exact shipped bindings use fixed roots; no binding falls back to importlib.import_module. RuntimeRegistry defaults trusted=True and CLI accepts an injected registry, so the word reviewed is a caller/process expectation, not an enforced review credential. The default installed invocation uses default_runtime_registry.

runner_source_identity_only.note: The loader checks regular-file/no-reparse plus device/inode/mode identity before, during, and after source read, then compiles and executes those bytes. It does not compare an expected source-content SHA-256; same-inode content edits are not pinned by this check.

review_assessment.qualification: Treat “reviewed programmatic callers” as intended governance, not a code-enforced gate: a caller can construct RuntimeRegistry(trusted=True) because trusted defaults True. The report separately identifies custom programmatic registries as outside the default trust boundary.
review_assessment.reachability_limit: All conclusions are static source traces. Custom broker/client/API reflection paths are possible out-of-registry surfaces, not proof of actual provider, CTP, or live execution.
review_assessment.official_status: All 460 current official checklist entries remain REVIEW_REQUIRED / NOT_AVAILABLE; zero rows authorize writes.
